headlines.title: 공휴일에도 24시간 가동한 외환시장
headlines.summary: 환율 1480원대 소폭 상승 변동성은 크지 않아 외환시장이 24시간 체제로 전환된 뒤 첫 공휴일인 17일 서울 을지로 하나은행 딜링룸에 원·달러 환율이 표시돼 있다.   /뉴스1 24시간 거래 체제로 전환된 이후 첫 공휴일(제헌절)인 17일 서울외환시장에서 원·달러 환율이 1480원대에서 소폭 상승했다.

headlines.title: [단독] 韓美거래소 8월 MOU …" 24시간 거래체계 협력 "
headlines.summary: 22년 만에 협약 틀 개편 추진 한국거래소가 미국 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE)와 24시간 거래체계 협력 등을 담은 업무협약(MOU) 체결에 나선다. 2004년 양측이 포괄적 업무협약을 맺은 지 22년 만에 협력 틀을 전면적으로 개편하고 범위를 확대한다는 점에서 의미가 있다.

headlines.title: 상반기 서울 아파트값, 18년만에 가장 많이 올라
headlines.summary: 주담대 한도 규제에도 5.07% 상승 공급 부족에 실수요자 매수 전환 15억이하 밀집지 상승 두드러져 사진은 14일 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워 서울스카이에서 바라본 강남 3구 아파트 모습. 2026.06.14 뉴시스 올해 상반기(1∼6월) 서울 아파트값 누적 상승률이 2008년 이후 가장 높은 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 수도권 전세거래 급감 여파 … 주택금융보증 7년만에 최저
headlines.summary: 주금공, 올해 32만건에 그쳐 토허제에 전세매물 실종되고 총량관리로 대출 줄어든 영향 한국주택금융공사(HF)가 공급하는 전세보증 등 주택금융보증이 부동산 규제에 따른 전세 매물 실종과 당국의 가계대출 강화 기조 여파 등으로 7년 만에 최저 수준으로 줄어들었다.

headlines.title: 금리인상 후폭풍 … 고령층부터 타격
headlines.summary: 취약차주 5명중 1명 60대 이상 대출 연체율도 4년새 2배로 고령 자영업자 평균 빚 3.9억 한국은행이 기준금리를 2.75%로 인상하며 긴축 통화정책으로 선회한 가운데 향후 시장금리가 따라 오를 때 고령층에 먼저 충격이 가해질 수 있다는 전망이 제기된다.

headlines.title: 60대이상 취약차주 빚 평균 1억원 … 30대보다 2배 많아
headlines.summary: 금리인상 직격탄 … 고령층 취약차주 비상 고령 자영업자 금융빚 405조 비은행 대출 10년새 7배 급증 매출 둔화·이자부담 이중고 신현송 "채무조정 등 필요" 챗GPT "취약차주 문제는 항상 염두에 두고 있다. 이 부분이야말로 정부와 금융당국의 조화로운 정책이 중요하다.

headlines.title: 中企 연체율 , 대기업 의 4배 … 금리인상 기조에 '좌불안석'
headlines.summary: 중기 57%, 돈벌어 이자도 못내 변동금리 대출 많아 부담 가중 본격적인 기준금리 인상 사이클이 시작되면서 경기 침체와 소비 부진 등으로 어려움을 겪고 있는 중소기업과 자영업자들의 재정 부담이 더 커질 것으로 보인다. 가뜩이나 연체율이 치솟는 상황에서 감당해야 할 이자가 불어나기 때문이다. 17일 금융감독원에 따르면 올해 4월 중소기업 연체율은 0.

headlines.title: 빗나간 예측에 남아도는 일자리 추경
headlines.summary: 예산정책처 2025년 결산 분석 본예산도 못쓴 사업에 증액 소부장 예산도 집행률 30%대 친환경차 전환, 15%사용 그쳐 "목적성·신속성 원칙 살려야" 정부는 고용 악화와 민생경제 위기에 대응하기 위해 지난해 두 차례 추가경정예산(추경)을 편성했다.

headlines.title: 최저임금 제도개선 착수 … 대상확대·임금차등 논의
headlines.summary: 내년도 최저임금이 시간당 1만700원으로 결정된 가운데 고용노동부가 되풀이되는 소모적 갈등을 끊어내기 위해 제도 개선에 본격 착수했다. 17일 관계부처에 따르면 고용노동부는 최근 '최저임금 결정 기준 합리화 및 운영 방식 개선에 관한 연구' 용역을 발주했다. 가장 큰 쟁점은 적용 대상이다.

headlines.title: 보호무역에 대응 … 韓, 중견국 협의체 'FIT-P' 가입
headlines.summary: 스위스·싱가포르 등 19개 회원국 WTO 이후 세계 통상규칙 모색 한국이 세계무역기구(WTO) 체제 이후의 새로운 통상 규칙을 모색하는 중견국 협의체인 ‘미래투자교역파트너십(FIT-P)’에 가입했다.

headlines.title: 일본의 AI 독립 선언 "제조업 특화 AI 육성"
headlines.summary: 소버린 AI 프로젝트 가동 소뱅·소니 등 44개社 참가 일본 정부 최대 1조엔 투입 일본이 소프트뱅크를 비롯한 44개 기업이 참여하는 국가 차원의 '소버린 AI(주권 인공지능)' 프로젝트를 본격 가동한다.

top5_headlines.title: 금리인상 후폭풍 … 고령층부터 타격

top5_headlines.title: 상반기 서울 아파트값, 18년만에 가장 많이 올라
top5_headlines.summary: 주담대 한도 규제에도 5.07% 상승 공급 부족에 실수요자 매수 전환 15억이하 밀집지 상승 두드러져 사진은 14일 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워 서울스카이에서 바라본 강남 3구 아파트 모습. 2026.06.14 뉴시스 올해 상반기(1∼6월) 서울 아파트값 누적 상승률이 2008년 이후 가장 높은 것으로 나타났다.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Per Capita GDP to Exceed $39,000 in 2026, Highest Growth in 5 Years
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's per capita GDP is projected to reach $39,164 this year, up 7.6% from last year, marking the largest increase in five years. This achievement is driven by robust semiconductor exports, with nominal growth rate reaching 12.3%, the highest level in 30 years.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Surge 5.07% in First Half of 2026, Highest in 18 Years
key_headlines.summary: Seoul's apartment prices rose 5.07% in the first half of 2026, the strongest performance since 2008, despite mortgage loan restrictions. The surge is driven by supply shortages and real demand shifting to affordable outer districts.

key_headlines.title: Japan Launches Sovereign AI Project with 44 Companies, $10 Billion Investment
key_headlines.summary: Japan's government has launched a national 'Sovereign AI' project involving 44 companies including SoftBank and Sony, with investments up to 1 trillion yen. The initiative aims to develop manufacturing-specialized AI independent of U.S. technology restrictions.

key_headlines.title: Elderly and Small Business Owners Hit Hard by Base Rate Increase
key_headlines.summary: Following the Bank of Korea's base rate hike to 2.75%, vulnerable borrowers face significant financial strain, with seniors accounting for 1 in 5 at-risk debtors. Loan delinquency rates have doubled in four years as elderly self-employed individuals carry average debts of 390 million won.

key_headlines.title: Housing Finance Guarantees Fall to 7-Year Low at 320,000 Cases
key_headlines.summary: Housing finance guarantees provided by Korea Housing Finance Corporation reached a seven-year low of 320,000 cases in 2026, due to disappearing jeonse inventory from property regulations and stricter household lending policies.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is showing strong momentum with per capita GDP approaching the $40,000 milestone and semiconductor exports driving unprecedented growth rates. However, this macroeconomic strength masks significant challenges for vulnerable populations, particularly elderly individuals and small business owners facing increased financial strain from rising interest rates. Seoul's real estate market is experiencing broad-based price appreciation with apartment values reaching 18-year highs despite mortgage regulations. Meanwhile, the financial sector is under pressure with rising loan delinquencies and deteriorating credit conditions for smaller borrowers. The contrast between economic growth and employment weakness continues to concern policymakers.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's per capita GDP is projected to reach $39,164 this year, representing a 7.6% increase and the largest five-year gain, driven primarily by semiconductor export surge. The nominal growth rate is estimated at 12.3%, the highest in 30 years, supported by sustained semiconductor demand. However, economic downside risks include slowing export growth from high bases, high exchange rates, interest rate hikes constraining consumer spending, and geopolitical uncertainty in the Middle East. The Bank of Korea's shift to monetary tightening after 42 months signals further rate increases ahead. Government initiatives include expanded non-capital region investment, with 27% of large corporations considering increased provincial investments within three years.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean financial markets remained volatile amid the base rate increase, with banking stocks surging while broader indices weakened, as higher rates improve bank profit margins. The KOSPI index faced significant downward pressure from semiconductor stock declines and global growth concerns, yet defensive sectors like food and beverage companies showed resilience. Korean stock markets have become a key barometer for global investor sentiment, with heightened correlation between KOSPI and NASDAQ reaching two-year highs. The market displayed typical risk-off characteristics with individual investors seeking safety and reduced exposure to volatile positions. Base rate increase expectations and potential further hikes dominated market sentiment and trading activity.
sections.Industry & Technology: Data center-specialized steel products are sold out for 2026, reflecting strong demand from AI and robotics industries requiring specialized infrastructure. The automotive industry is shifting focus from battery competition to electric drive systems, with Chinese companies gaining efficiency advantages through advanced rotor and stator designs. All-solid-state battery production is expected to begin in 2027-2028, with Korea positioning itself for significant market opportunities as global manufacturers accelerate commercialization timelines. The U.S. Department of Commerce's first major investment project involves strategic coordination on energy and shipbuilding sectors. Large corporations are prioritizing AI-related investments as their top growth driver, with 33% citing AI acquisition as the primary investment rationale.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment prices have breached previous highs across 20 districts, with five additional districts breaking all-time price records in 2026, driven by concentrated demand in affordable outer areas. Jeonse (long-term lease) inventory has collapsed by up to 82% year-over-year in some districts, particularly affordable neighborhoods, due to rising property values and stricter lease regulations. Real demand is shifting toward existing apartments rather than expensive new construction, as mortgage restrictions and high supply-side prices direct buyers toward the secondary market. All-time high prices are expected across Seoul by year-end as real demand continues flowing to outer districts within mortgage limits. The government is pursuing a 310,000 housing unit supply increase by 2031 as the core solution to address affordability concerns.
sections.International Economy: Global tariff policies are in flux with Trump administration threats of broad 10% tariffs and country-specific 25% rates, creating significant uncertainty for Korean exporters and investors. Canada is actively resisting Trump's proposed tariffs, noting its previous assistance with U.S. wildfire relief efforts. Brazil faces U.S. retaliatory tariffs under Section 301 following trade disputes, with investor sentiment shifting toward political opposition. The USMCA trade agreement renewal is under negotiation, with implications for continental trade flows. Forced labor tariffs and extended forced labor regulations are creating urgent investment pressures on Korean companies as the Trump administration intensifies economic coercion strategies.
sections.AI & Economy: China's AI development is advancing rapidly despite U.S. semiconductor restrictions, with startups like Moonshot AI releasing competitive models approaching U.S. performance levels through algorithmic optimization and data efficiency improvements. Chinese open-weight models are now matching or exceeding leading U.S. models, fundamentally shifting competitive dynamics in the AI industry toward cost and accessibility factors alongside pure performance metrics. AI is becoming a critical solution to China's overcapacity problems in steel and petrochemical industries, with OECD projecting global steel overproduction rising from 640 million tons to 745 million tons by 2028. Youth employment opportunities are contracting due to AI implementation across industries, prompting policy forums on restoring learning and skill development during early career stages. Corporate investment in AI is accelerating as companies view AI capability as essential for future competitiveness.
sections.Others: The government is exploring enhanced management of single-stock leveraged ETFs through extended hedging window times for liquidity providers rather than delisting, recognizing the practical constraints of complete product removal. The U.S. Federal Reserve and international central banks are maintaining high rates for extended periods due to persistent inflation risks linked to Middle East supply disruptions. Won-denominated settlement initiatives are expanding internationally, with JP Morgan and Mitsubishi Bank branches offering Korean won accounts and financing to facilitate trade and investment. Iran and other regional actors are escalating military activities with implications for global energy markets and international trade routes. Multiple geopolitical flashpoints remain, with U.S. policy emphasizing economic pressure through sanctions and trade measures as strategic tools.
